sources.title: Galactic North

decisions.reason: The holoship reference establishes a generation society but does not settle labor-independent basic access.
decisions.analysis: A life-support system, a large passenger population and advanced propulsion do not alone establish who controls production or whether necessities depend on work.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading under the pace instruction.

decisions.reason: The quick sources describe a working salvage/trade economy, without a verified automatic support or unnecessary-employment mechanism.
decisions.analysis: Quoins and ancient artifacts are not proof of post-work distribution. Later currency disruption does not retroactively supply a welfare economy.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve as a far-future trade comparison; skip a trilogy investigation.

decisions.reason: The discovery label Mechanism-dominated Earth is unverified for Troika.
decisions.analysis: The identified Troika description concerns the Matryoshka and cosmonauts. The same archive also contains other Reynolds books; nearby Mechanism wording cannot be imported across works.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading; correct the lead only if a clear Troika-specific economic source appears.

decisions.reason: The simulated sanctuary does not establish a durable material-support society for a defined living human population.
decisions.analysis: Thom's comfort is not proof of bodily security, the other crew members are not automatically living leisure residents, and the alien caretaker is not proven AI. Original-story and animated continuity details cannot be merged.
decisions.follow_up: Keep as a care/illusion comparison; no full-story or episode reconstruction in this pass.

decisions.reason: Zima's artistic life and robot origins do not establish an entire robot-served human economy.
decisions.analysis: The episode focuses on one android's chosen work and transformation, not general household allocation or a human nonworking population.
decisions.follow_up: Skip the broad society lead; do not infer general guarantees from an exceptional artist.

decisions.reason: Greenfly expansion displaces human civilization rather than documenting a human population maintained in post-work security.
decisions.analysis: Vegetated machine biospheres, passive colonist scans and fugitives are different things. Neither lost humans nor unoccupied habitats create a 100% nonworking denominator.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve as an autonomous machine-ecology comparison and skip further investigation.

review_notes: Reference-led fast dispositions without full-text recovery. Six unsupported/boundary leads do not inflate the retained count.
The Troika discovery label is not verified by a mixed-work review archive. Mechanism facts from another novel are not borrowed.
Aquila Rift versions are kept distinct; an alien caregiver is not automatically AI, and simulated comfort is not equivalent to reliable bodily support.
Zima's exceptional resources and Greenfly's machine-tended vegetation do not establish human leisure societies.
